findings.issue: Giocoso means playful/humorous in character; it does not prescribe a specific light, detached touch. The 'What your hand and arm do' text conflates giocoso with a leggiero/staccato articulation, which is misleading (giocoso passages can be legato).
findings.evidence: "Use short, quick finger movements. Lift the fingers briskly off the keys. Avoid pressing deeply into the keys."
findings.fix: Describe giocoso as a character direction (light, buoyant, good-humoured) rather than prescribing a fixed light-finger touch; note the actual articulation depends on the printed markings.
